description: Find upcoming electronic/dance events, concerts and festivals for a region. Specify a region either by latitude+longitude (returns events within ~75 miles) or by location_ids. Optionally filter by date window, name, and festivals-only.

latitude.description: Region center latitude (pair with longitude), e.g. 37.77 for SF.

location_ids.description: Comma-separated EDMtrain location ids (from the locations tool). Alternative to lat/long.

longitude.description: Region center longitude (pair with latitude), e.g. -122.42 for SF.

state.description: Optional 2-letter state filter when using lat/long, e.g. "CA".

name: events
